title: Seasoned and Established Credit Builder Accounts: Returned-Payment Fee Shares
content:
The returned-payment fee on a Credit Builder account is reduced for an account that is seasoned or established.

## Seasoned and established accounts

- An account open 12 months or more with 12 or more payments credited (payments posted to the account less payments returned on it) is a seasoned account, and its fee is multiplied by the seasoned share of 0.8; months open are whole calendar months from the open date, each complete on the day of the month matching the opening day or, in a month too short for that day, on the first day of the following month.
- An account open at least 6 months with at least 6 payments credited, but either open fewer than 12 months or with fewer than 12 payments credited, is an established account, and its fee is multiplied by the established share of 0.9.
- Any other account's fee is not reduced for seasoning.

Payments credited are the number of the account's payment entries less the number of its returned-payment entries. The open date is the date the account activated. The share multiplies the fee before it is rounded to the cent.

| Months open | Payments credited | Account | Share |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 or more | 12 or more | seasoned | 0.8 |
| 12 or more | 6 to 11 | established | 0.9 |
| 6 to 11 | 6 or more | established | 0.9 |
| fewer than 6 | any | neither | no reduction |
| any | fewer than 6 | neither | no reduction |

## Example (hypothetical account)

An account opened 15 January with 13 payment entries and 1 returned-payment entry has 12 payments credited; on 15 January of the next year it has 12 whole months open and is seasoned, on 14 January of the next year it has 11 and is established.
